question: How does abstaining from food by day affect the death associated with aging?
premises: Death associated with age is the target
The practitioner will go beyond it
inference: Through abstaining from food by day, one will overcome death associated with aging.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is slightly ambiguous; interpreted as going beyond or overcoming age-death.
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome the death of old age.
